gates.name: PARITY
gates.why: with the new behaviour off the candidate emits its parent's action

gates.name: SAFETY
tail: no failures: every episode finished DONE with a real reward,
a well-formed action every turn, and the overage bank untouched.
gates.why: no crash, well-formed action every turn, inside the time budget

gates.name: POPULATION
gates.why: enough distinct behaviours that a win rate is not one game repeated

sample_audit.needs: WHOLE episodes at BOTH seats, not sampled turns
sample_audit.why: a divergence can first appear at any turn, and seat 1 sees a trimmed observation that seat 0 does not

sample_audit.needs: several seeds and several opponent kinds, including an idle one
sample_audit.why: a crash is usually a state the agent reaches rarely

sample_audit.needs: EFFECTIVE n, distinct plans, seat balance, and the share of games the baseline had already won
sample_audit.why: a win rate over near-duplicates is one game repeated, and a pool of games we already won cannot falsify a claim about being behind

sample_audit.needs: the SAME seed, seat and recorded opponent for both agents
sample_audit.why: common random numbers only pays if the pairing is exact; below about twenty the sign test cannot resolve a realistic effect
sample_audit.note: smallest detectable win rate at 80 % power: 72 %

sample_audit.needs: enough games per opponent for mu and sigma to mean anything
sample_audit.why: sigma from a handful of games is mostly its own error
sample_audit.note: sigma is estimated across opponents, so EFFECTIVE n carries it
